text: The Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on October 17, 2017 adopted recommendations to amend the parking regulations on Edwin Avenue, north of Dupont Street. Unfortunately, since the 'no stopping' regulation was introduced in late fall 2017, little changed on this section of Edwin Avenue. At 15 metres, the current 'no stopping' rule does very little to a) prevent parking too close to the Edwin Avenue/Dupont Street intersection and b) lessen congestion. The intent of this motion is to extend the length of this 'no stopping' rule in order to reduce congestion.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened item TE27.87 entitled "Junction Triangle Traffic Management Committee - Traffic Management Plan, Phase 2", with respect to Recommendation 3. 2. Deleted Recommendation 3 of Item TE27.87 and replace it with the following new Recommendation 3: "3. Toronto and East York Community Council prohibit stopping at all times on both sides of Edwin Avenue, between Dupont Street and a point 28 metres further north."
